name: Health Innovation Research Day 2027
organizer: Carle Illinois College of Medicine, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
description: Health Innovation Research Day is Carle Illinois College of Medicine's annual research and innovation showcase, free to attend, with poster and oral presentation sessions for Carle Health residents and CI MED students. The 2027 edition had not been scheduled as of September 2026; the event typically falls in early April with an abstract deadline in early March.
